production_metadata.production_description: Submitter: ma4ypic4y. Existing proof reused under Apache-2.0 from https://github.com/mlgraham/lean-eval-dimitrov-submission at 661e66a9fb0830eea5084f2b6ca88a10813749df. Original attribution: Claude Fable 5 / various models, as reported upstream. Contribution: five source files adapted for Lean 4.35 / Mathlib API changes; original full-proof authorship is not claimed. Fresh local source-only verification of all 87 files passed both unchanged official kernels against benchmark 0e093293afbe96be91504ae6e44947876d3fc84e. Exact hashes and provenance are committed in the submitted repository. This local PASS is not a claim of server acceptance. Packaging repair: add the benchmark lakefile.toml discovery marker and toolchain metadata; all previously verified Submission sources are byte-identical. Supersedes submission 01a10085-0cd1-74f5-8baf-187c0e8f3619. Harness: Codex multi-agent proof-porting workflow with the unmodified pinned LeanEval comparator (Lean and Nanoda). Human selected the benchmark, research direction and submission identity, and authorized submission. Existing public proof reused; no claim that the campaign produced the original full proof. This uses the documented temporary issue intake because the service evaluation-completion builder rejects the benchmark RC3 toolchain; the same corrected commit is in service run https://github.com/leanprover/lean-eval-submissions/actions/runs/37107427923. No change to verifier, benchmark pins, proof sources or attribution is requested. The intended publication date is a best estimate consistent with the existing scheduled service submission; it is not a claim that this adapted source is already public.
